title: KSB video observations and booking control
details: Calendar items now open a full detail view instead of only showing a short summary
Manual reviews, observations, witness visits, meetings and other bookings can be edited, rescheduled to another date or deleted from the calendar
Completed review and observation records remain visible in the calendar but are protected from accidental deletion
Video Observation and Witness Video now work for apprenticeship KSB courses using the practical sub-categories already defined in the Evia course pack
Bricklayer, Site Carpenter and Architectural Joiner observations therefore use practical areas such as cavity walling, installing a trussed roof or machining components rather than NVQ unit numbers
NVQ video observations keep the existing Unit to LO to AC workflow unchanged
